{{Quote|She took Snoke's escape craft.|[[Armitage Hux]], to Kylo Ren|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
'''Snoke's escape shuttle''',<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> also referred to as '''Snoke's escape craft''',<ref name="Episode VIII" /> was a [[shuttle]]<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> owned by [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]]. After his [[death]] at the hands of [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] during the [[Battle of Oetchi]], [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] used it to escape from the [[First Order]]'s [[flagship]] the ''[[Supremacy]]'',<ref name="Episode VIII" /> then later abandoned it in space among the shattered ruins of the [[First Order Navy|First Order's fleet]].<ref name="Junior Novel">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]''</ref>
